constraints.action: use digital, on-screen, readings for pressure tracings
record WHVP for a minimum of 1 minute
measure free hepatic vein pressure in the hepatic vein within 2-3 cm of its confluence with the inferior vena cava (IVC)
rule out porto-sinusoidal vascular disorder (PSVD) in patients with chronic liver disease and clinical signs of portal hypertension but with HVPG <10 mmHg
constraints.source_section: Diagnosis of CSPH in patients with cirrhosis

constraints.action: use DOACs in patients with Child-Pugh C cirrhosis outside study protocols
use Rifaximin for primary or secondary prophylaxis of SBP
